reviewDispositions.rationale: lesson.json now declares scene-clinical-wrap-up claims-mapped; all four applicable claims include that scene; the scene has a source note listing every claim and supporting source; and its medical and meter details remain explicitly stipulated fictional teaching material.

The NIST attribution is now limited to experimental factors, responses, and controlled or uncontrolled inputs and explicitly excludes its design-of-experiments aliasing sense from the third-variable definition; Fumo-dos-Santos and Ferreira remain credited for the confounder and causal-pathway boundary.

The reviewed answer logic was independently recomputed and remains correct: a baseline negative control does not rescue a run whose known-response positive control failed, so an unknown zero cannot support target absence; the integrated item still requires all three confounder checks.
The same complete clinical-scene manifest, claim-ledger, glossary, and learner-visible source-note repair incorporates this overlapping major finding, including claim-controls-have-limits.
assessment.json already contained lessonVersion 0.2.0 in the exact frozen candidate commit; the review's stated 0.1.1 value was not present, so editing that field would make no change.

The clinical wrap-up now gives a concrete meter example with a high-signal positive-control simulator and zero-signal negative-control simulator. The exact suggested real-device materials were not used because the existing sources do not establish device-specific instructions; the retained example is explicitly fictional and non-instructional.

The four-point integrated assessment now evaluates independent, dependent, and controlled variables, all three confounder checks, both control roles, and failed-positive-control interpretation in a fictional, patient-free medical-device bench scenario.
The clear opening, concrete zero-reading problem, and controlled-variable versus control-condition distinction were preserved unchanged.

The pack contains no third-party assets, media, datasets, quotations, adapted expression, raw HTML, entities, JavaScript, remote embeds, executable code, unsafe TeX, secrets, or identifiable learner or patient data.

rationale: The exact frozen candidate was unchanged except for the later addition of the two cited review artifacts. Based on their disclosed metadata and the operator-provided confirmation of equivalent non-dismissed COMMENTED transports, standard-lesson-v3 has exactly two eligible advisory inputs: one academic and one learning-design review, two request-changes verdicts, two distinct declared runs, and two distinct declared providers/model families. This is attested provenance, not verified independence, and the declared learning-design conflict is preserved. All ten findings are disposed: seven are incorporated and three require no change, including the demonstrably stale assessment-version finding. The single revision repairs the blocking evidence bridge, preserves accurate teaching, adds the requested concrete and assessed medical-context transfer without making clinical claims, and corrects attribution and rights-ledger defects. Scoped verification and the final accessibility-and-rights audit found no unresolved academic, assessment, accessibility, safety, privacy, security, attribution, or reuse blocker. Merge is therefore justified subject to operator substitution of the real final content commit and runtime identity, execution of the prohibited repository checks, and the maintainer-only publication transition.
dissent: Both advisory reviewers requested changes to the original candidate; neither reviewer saw or approved this final revision.

The learning-design review proposed real glucose-meter control materials. The final revision preserves the requested concrete medical context but uses explicitly fictional bench simulators because the existing evidence record does not support real-device instructions.

The learning-design review's assessment-version finding conflicts with the frozen candidate, which already states version 0.2.0; that indexed finding is retained and disposed as no change required rather than silently discarded.
